speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Given your age and symptoms of feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting, I need to ask a few quick questions to ensure your safety. Can you tell me exactly how many days old you are when these symptoms started?

REQUEST TEST: Electrolytes, CBC, Blood Gas.
REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Tests.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Bilious vomiting. I also have Feeding intolerance, No fever, Vomiting started within first day after birth. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Since the vomiting is bilious and started in the first day of life, this is a surgical emergency; have you noticed any abdominal distension or if your stools have been green or black?

REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus.
